decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are closely related to the firm's existing dental lab materials and thermoforming capabilities, so its absorptive capacity allows it to learn from early results and improve rather than drop the product.
PETG thermoforming blanks build on the firm's core material and dental lab knowledge, making it well positioned to assimilate market feedback and keep the product.
UV-curing lacquer leverages the firm's in-house R&D and coatings materials expertise within lab workflows, giving it the ability to interpret early performance and continue improving the product.

Although custom hearing protection earmolds relate to the firm's hearing-care channel and custom manufacturing, the earlier drop of the broader earmold line suggests weaker absorptive capacity in this area, raising the chance of dropping but still below 50%.
